title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) Calculators
text: egfr vectorised R toolkit estimating glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) creatinine clearance serum creatinine, cystatin C, . implements 19 validated adult, paediatric, neonatal equations, plus helpers body surface area, KDIGO CKD staging, unit conversion. package inspired kidney.epi package ported equation set used eGFR.app. equations screening tools substitute measured GFR clinical judgement.

title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) Calculators
code: library(egfr)  # CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine (race-free) — recommended for adults egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(creatinine = 1.0, age = 50, sex = "female") #> 68.6  # Fully vectorised: pass vectors for any argument egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(   creatinine = c(0.8, 1.2, 1.5),   age        = c(40, 65, 72),   sex        = c("female", "male", "female") )  # Units: supply creatinine in umol/L instead of mg/dL egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(88.4, 50, "female", creatinine_units = "umol/l")  # Classify the result into a KDIGO stage ckd_stage(egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(1.0, 50, "female")) #> "G2"

title: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) Calculators
text: egfr_*() functions return unrounded values mL/min/1.73m^2, except egfr_cockcroft_gault(), returns creatinine clearance mL/min. title: Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance — egfr_cockcroft_gault
text: equation returns creatinine clearance mL/min, normalised 1.73 m^2 directly comparable egfr_*() functions. Creatinine clearance overestimates true GFR creatinine secreted renal tubules. equation derived 249 hospitalised adults aged 18-92, male, using non-standardised (Jaffe) creatinine; therefore IDMS-traceable differs systematically modern eGFR equations. 15% downward adjustment women (0.85 factor) stated original 1976 publication, though asserted rather derived, derivation cohort male.

title: EKFC creatinine eGFR (2021) — egfr_ekfc_cr
text: default Q follows published EKFC specification. ages 2-25 years Q sex-specific polynomial age (given authors micromol/L scale converted mg/dL): $$\ln(Q_{male}) = 3.200 + 0.259 - 0.543 \ln() - 0.00763 ^2 +   0.0000790 ^3$$ $$\ln(Q_{female}) = 3.080 + 0.177 - 0.223 \ln() - 0.00596 ^2 +   0.0000686 ^3$$ age 25 onwards Q constant adult values 0.90 mg/dL (80 micromol/L) males 0.70 mg/dL (62 micromol/L) females. polynomial adult plateau differ roughly 1% age-25 knot; step part published specification preserved deliberately. Population-specific adult Q values (e.g. 1.02 / 0.74 mg/dL Black Europeans) may supplied via q.

title: egfr 2.0.0
text: release corrects two equations returned clinically wrong values paediatric patients, removes one function implemented experimental equation.

title: egfr 2.0.0
text: egfr_ekfc_cr() now uses correct reference Q specification published Pottel et al. (2021). egfr_fas_cr() now applies published age- sex-specific Q values Table 1 Pottel et al. (2016). Previous versions used adult Q (0.90 / 0.70 mg/dL) every age, overestimated eGFR ~246% infants ~76% 10-year-old. Q shared boys girls ages 1-14, becomes sex-specific ages 15-19, reaches adult values age 20. Adult results (age >= 20) unchanged. egfr_ckid_u25_cr_extended() removed. kappa extension age 30 (0.995^(age - 25)) experimental feature. Use egfr_ckid_u25_cr() within validated range.

title: egfr 2.0.0
text: ckd_stage() longer errors logical NA (e.g. ckd_stage(NA)) returns NA expected.

title: egfr 2.0.0
text: Corrected citation egfr_neonatal(). egfr_ckdepi_cys_2021() now documents use four-decimal age factor 0.9962 Table 2 Inker et al. (2021), resulting ~1.2-1.6% difference ages 60-80 relative calculators use rounded 0.996 printed 2012 paper National Kidney Foundation. Added published validity ranges documentation egfr_ekfc_cr() (ages 2-90; previous claim 2-120 incorrect), egfr_ekfc_cys(), egfr_fas_cr(), egfr_bis_cr() (age >= 70), egfr_lund_malmo() (adults), egfr_schwartz() (ages 1-16), egfr_ckid_u25_cr() (ages 1-25), egfr_capa(), egfr_neonatal() (term-born, postnatal days 0-28). egfr_cockcroft_gault() now documents returns creatinine clearance (overestimates GFR tubular secretion) derived using non-standardised Jaffe creatinine.

title: egfr 2.0.0
text: Added test-reference-values.R, validates every equation coefficients written directly original publications, including EKFC FAS reference Q tables continuity checks age knots. previous suite largely re-derived values using package’s internals detect mis-transcribed equation.

title: egfr 1.1.2
text: CITATION file now reports installed package version dynamically instead hardcoded value. Added maintainer’s ORCID Zenodo archive metadata (.zenodo.json) package can cited via DOI.

title: egfr 1.1.0
text: Fixed Full Age Spectrum (FAS) creatinine equation (egfr_fas_cr()) ages 40: creatinine-ratio exponent now correctly -1 (plain reciprocal) published Pottel et al. (2016), rather -0.88. changes returned eGFR values patients older 40. egfr_ekfc_cr(), egfr_ekfc_cys(), egfr_ekfc_cr_cys() gain optional q argument (q_cr / q_cys combined equation) supply population-, assay-, individual-specific reference Q value. default (NULL) continues use built-EKFC reference Q, existing code unaffected.

title: egfr 0.1.0
text: Initial release. 20 eGFR / creatinine-clearance equations: CKD-EPI 2021 (creatinine, cystatin C, combined), CKD-EPI 2009, CKD-EPI 2012 cystatin C, MDRD, Cockcroft-Gault, EKFC (creatinine, cystatin C, combined), FAS, Lund-Malmoe, Berlin Initiative Study, Schwartz bedside, CKiD U25 (creatinine, cystatin C, combined, extended), CAPA, neonatal eGFR. Helpers: bsa(), ckd_stage(), creatinine unit conversion.
